label: Acoustic Pop
style_parts: warm acoustic pop built on fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar, warm round bass, hand percussion, restrained kick and snare, small piano or vocal harmony only when the story opens, 80-112 bpm, 4/4 with a relaxed pocket, close conversational and melodic lead with crisp words and modest embellishment, dry close upfront vocal.
{gender} lead, sung melody with long held open vowels, clear diction.
The lead SPEAKS the lines tagged Spoken in a plain natural voice over the music, and SINGS the lines tagged Sung with long held notes.
Only the short intro and the final outro are spoken; the full band keeps playing continuously under them.
ending_clause_added_by_ending_qc: , natural resolved ending, final chord rings out and fades
negative_tags: rap, rapping, choir, reverb, echo, band dropout, acapella sections, talk-singing, monotone delivery
skeleton_rule: Intro (spoken opener) -> Vocalise (optional, a short wordless lead-in, never a forced opening) -> Verse -> Pre-Chorus -> Hook (the payoff: at or after the build-up, at the story beat where its words become true) -> verses and pre-choruses between hooks -> Product passage on beat 8 -> remaining hooks evenly -> last hook near 90% -> Outro (spoken CTA) -> [End].
villain_pain_lyric_guidance: VILLAIN IN THE LYRICS (Suno): name the villain in the verses, carry a pain line with real stakes and consequences, then turn to the rise in the hook. First person, present tense, concrete nouns -- the listener must feel the pain and the problem in the depth of their soul before the rise lands.
